project.name: MarketOps AI Workbench
project.statusPolicy: A task is completed only after its acceptance check passes and completion evidence is recorded. The generated status report is not a substitute for product or market validation.

milestones.name: Foundation
milestones.goal: Establish the product contract, architecture, safety boundaries, and open-source baseline.

evidence.note: Approved planning specification defines user, job, P0, non-goals, and human controls.

selfCheck.method: Reviewed against the agreed independent-workbench scope and documentation link check.

evidence.note: Defines independent deployment, deterministic scheduling, connector isolation, and P0 deployment direction.

evidence.note: Defines project state, sources, tasks, permissions, audit, and retention boundaries.

milestones.name: M0: Samples and technical validation
milestones.goal: Prove the riskiest inputs and deterministic engines before feature development.

tasks.title: Prepare validation project set
tasks.acceptance: Two anonymized historical projects and one executable test project have an approved data-use record and cover proposal, schedule, change, and retrospective inputs.

tasks.title: Document parsing spike
tasks.acceptance: The selected parser extracts cited sections, tables, and source coordinates from the validation set with documented failures.

tasks.title: Scheduling and critical-path spike
tasks.acceptance: A deterministic prototype recalculates dependencies, workdays, buffers, and critical path for the executable test project.

tasks.title: Hybrid retrieval and citation spike
tasks.acceptance: Representative queries return workspace-scoped, cited results; an isolation test finds no cross-customer result.

tasks.title: Dependency and license decision
tasks.acceptance: Chosen dependencies, versions, licenses, maintenance signals, and alternatives are recorded with no unresolved blocker.

tasks.title: M0 review gate
tasks.acceptance: The validation set, all spike results, risks, and M1 implementation decision are reviewed against the M0 exit criteria.

milestones.name: M1: Proposal-to-schedule vertical slice
milestones.goal: Turn an approved proposal into a usable, reviewable execution plan.

tasks.title: Project, file, and approved-proposal import
tasks.acceptance: A user can create a project, retain the source file, and select an approved proposal version.

tasks.title: Deliverable extraction and review
tasks.acceptance: Extracted deliverables, milestones, constraints, and assumptions retain source citations and require user approval.

tasks.title: Editable WBS and deterministic schedule
tasks.acceptance: A user can edit WBS, dependencies, dates, and buffers; schedule changes recalculate deterministically.

tasks.title: Execution state, export, and audit
tasks.acceptance: Task status, blockers, actual dates, CSV/XLSX export, audit entries, and error recovery work for the validation project.

tasks.title: M1 review gate
tasks.acceptance: One anonymized project moves from approved proposal to an accepted executable schedule without critical dependency omissions.

milestones.name: M2: Knowledge base and project learning
milestones.goal: Make approved historical knowledge reusable without leaking customer material.

tasks.title: Workspace-scoped document ingestion and hybrid retrieval
tasks.acceptance: Documents are indexed with citations and retrieval respects project, client, and workspace boundaries.

tasks.title: Project capsule, feedback, and candidate knowledge
tasks.acceptance: A completed project produces traceable candidate knowledge with outcome feedback and version history.

tasks.title: Knowledge approval and reuse evaluation
tasks.acceptance: A user approves, scopes, rejects, or revokes knowledge; project B can cite approved knowledge from project A.

tasks.title: M2 review gate
tasks.acceptance: An isolation test and a usefulness evaluation pass with no unapproved cross-project reuse.

milestones.name: M3: Market signals and impact analysis
milestones.goal: Connect observed external changes to confirmed project assumptions and work.

tasks.title: Source-managed signal ingestion
tasks.acceptance: A user can add legal sources and manual signals with source, time, confidence, and deduplication state.

tasks.title: Impact mapping and review
tasks.acceptance: A signal maps to assumptions, decisions, deliverables, and tasks with an explainable proposed impact.

tasks.title: Approved change workflow
tasks.acceptance: The system never changes a proposal or schedule automatically; approved changes create an audit trail.

tasks.title: M3 review gate
tasks.acceptance: A real validation case produces a useful, explainable action while false-positive noise remains within the agreed threshold.

milestones.name: M4: Reporting, Feishu, and team operation
milestones.goal: Support small-team operation while preserving the independent core product.

tasks.title: Report and retrospective exports
tasks.acceptance: Weekly risk reports and retrospectives render from audited project state and are editable before export.

tasks.title: Official Feishu connector
tasks.acceptance: The optional connector uses official APIs, least privilege, revocation, sync status, and retries.

tasks.title: Roles, approval, and portfolio view
tasks.acceptance: A small team can use role-limited project access and approvals with a portfolio risk view.

tasks.title: Private-deployment operations
tasks.acceptance: Docker deployment, health checks, backup, restore, and migration documentation are tested.

tasks.title: M4 review gate
tasks.acceptance: A small team completes one project cycle without continuous developer handholding.

milestones.name: M5: Commercial validation and expansion
milestones.goal: Use paid or repeated use to decide what to build next.

tasks.title: Repeat-use and payment experiment
tasks.acceptance: At least one real user repeats use in a second project and completes a payment or deposit test under a documented offer.

tasks.title: Packaging decision
tasks.acceptance: Evidence supports a decision among hosted cloud, private deployment, and implementation service; pricing assumptions are documented.

tasks.title: Expansion prioritization
tasks.acceptance: Feishu follow-ons, WeCom, GEO, media monitoring, PPTX, and additional templates are ranked by observed demand and cost.
